question:

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9468fc12fb235adbef69137e8ea31a64a381b1e107b34b6ed6af8d9477acd97.png] 

The logic followed here is:

EMAILS : VILXPB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28dcab9a9fd9da439b7a90f40d779acb24c00be68f707ada264a5b169e0733af.png] 

JOINED : GBQFRG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30aefa92921e51611057870cc2c756f406158517f9ea4b26dd4934f16089d890.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38490d2e81da1e27463888b97b2f3c5ea38653a5d488a792f97d33d97f56fcdd.png]
